# EM 385-1-1 8 Hour Refresher Training for Site Safety and Health Officers (SSHOs)

> 8-hour online annual refresher for Site Safety and Health Officers on USACE and military construction projects, aligned with the 2024 edition of the EM 385-1-1 Safety and Health Requirements Manual. Available in English and Spanish. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 8 hours; 9 modules, 29 lessons, final exam
- Credits: 0.8 CEU
- Price: $99.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7; SCORM, virtual instructor-led and in-person formats also available
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Prerequisites: none formally; designed for SSHOs who completed initial EM 385-1-1 training
- Certificate: certificate of completion from HAZWOPER OSHA Training; valid 12 months
- SSHOs must complete at least 8 hours of continuing safety education each year
- Not government-approved: federal agencies do not approve or endorse any EM 385-1-1 training course

## Modules (with EM 385-1-1 chapters)
1. Introduction to EM 385-1-1 and Safety Culture
2. Safety and Health Program Management (Ch. 1-2)
3. Sanitation, Medical and First Aid (Ch. 3)
4. Personal Protective and Lifesaving Equipment (Ch. 5)
5. Electrical Safety and Hazardous Energy Control (Ch. 11-12)
6. Tools and Equipment (Ch. 13)
7. Material Handling, Storage and Disposal (Ch. 14)
8. Fall Protection (Ch. 21-24)
9. Excavation, Trenching and Underground Construction (Ch. 25-26)
